summary: Continuation of the 大盘 (TAIEX index) case studies for 2005-2007, all built on equal-distance (等幅) measured moves. It finishes the 2005 example (破底翻 long, 假突破 short, 跌幅满足 5681), then shows the 2005-06 破底翻 + neckline breakout run to 涨幅满足 (7523 vs high 7476) and its rare V-reversal exit via the three-day low / uptrend-line break, the 2006 假突破 short to 跌幅满足 6291, the 2006-07 weekly chart computing three successive 涨幅满足 targets from the 5618 low (7523, 8090, 9687), the 2007 复合式头肩顶 (double-head measured like an M top, target 7333) that turned into a 破底翻, and the start of the July 2007 爆量假突破 (9807) with 跌幅满足 8139. Each case lists entry, stop, % risk and % profit, and the master-quote boxes stress cutting losses quickly.

patterns.structure: After a decline reaches (or nears) 跌幅满足, price undercuts a prior low and then recovers (e.g. 2005-10-31 off 5618; 2006-03-30 after the 6436/6344 lows; 2007-03 mid-month after 7306). Confirmation comes when it then breaks the consolidation neckline (e.g. 2006-04-03).
patterns.stop: Below the long red candle's low on the signal day (5851, also near the neckline), or below the extreme low (5618), or below the pre-破底翻 prior low (6436, 7637). Risks quoted 1.4%-2.2%.

target.formula: 涨幅满足 = later swing low + (prior high − first low), computed once price clears the prior high

confirmation: Breakout of the consolidation neckline after the 破底翻; neckline resistance turns support (颈线压力变支撑，支撑不破看涨幅满足) (p143, p148).
On the weekly chart a 破底翻 may appear only as a lower shadow (周线为下影线) (p148, p150).
invalidation: Close below the 破底翻 stop low (long-red low / pre-破底翻 low).
Breaking the up-trend line or the three-day low after reaching target ends the long (p144).

patterns.structure: Price reaches near 涨幅满足, breaks out above the prior high/neckline, then falls back below it and below the up-trend line; neckline that had turned support is lost (多头看支撑，跌破支撑便属转弱). The 2007-07-26 version comes with near-record volume (爆量假突破).
patterns.entry: Short on confirmation: 2005-08-08 ~6380; 2006-05-11 ~7270 when price breaks the up-trend line and the low 7278 of the 5/4 volume breakout red candle (also the 'three-day low'). Add on the break of the rebound low (6791 on 2006-06-05).
patterns.stop: Prior high (6481), or the high of the trend-line-break black candle (7361); for add-ons, standing back above the line (站回线上停损).

target.formula: 跌幅满足 = rebound high − (top − first low), computed once price breaks the rebound low (假突破跌深反弹后再破前低)

confirmation: Break of the up-trend line (跌破上升趋势线).
Volume: 带量回跌 after the target (p144); 2007-07-26 爆出几乎与历史大量相同的历史次天量 = very clear long-term sell signal (p151).
Break of the rebound low triggers the 跌幅满足 calculation.
invalidation: Price stands back above the broken line / prior high (stop).
A brief rally back above the broken-bottom neckline that fails to exceed the rebound high (6186) does not cancel the 跌幅满足 view (p142).

patterns.structure: Left shoulder 7716.85, double head 7999.42 / 7990.55 (like an M top), right shoulder 7950.20; neckline ~7599 (lows 7599.55, 7637.54; rising trendline also drawn from 7369.09). Head formed over ~three months; 2007-03-01 volume break of the neckline completes it.
patterns.entry: Short on the volume neckline break, ~7670 (2007-03-01).

target.formula: Measured like an M top: neckline_at_break − (midpoint of the two head highs − neckline)
target.worked_example: midpoint of heads ~7996 − neckline 7599 = ~397; break point ~7730 − 397 = 7333 (low 7306 in ~4 trading days).

confirmation: 带量跌破颈线 (volume neckline break)
Neckline resistance not reclaimed → keep looking for 跌幅满足
invalidation: V-reversal straight back above the neckline = 破底翻 buy signal (happened here, leading to new highs) (p150).
A shorter seeking the second-wave target must stop out once the 破底翻 is confirmed (p150).

rules.rule: Once the decline breaks the rebound low, compute 跌幅满足; a brief rebound above the broken-bottom neckline that fails to clear the rebound high keeps the 跌幅满足 view.
rules.quote_zh: 只是这波曾短暂拉回破底的颈线之上，但未过反弹高点6186点，后续再破底后就型态而言，仍续看跌幅满足。

rules.rule: 破底翻 buy with stop at the signal day's long red low (also near the neckline).
rules.quote_zh: 2005年5月5日破底翻买进约可买在5930点附近，停损设在当日长红低点5851点，也是颈线附近，风险约1.4%，达涨幅满足6315点附近获利约6.5%。

rules.rule: Short on a confirmed false breakout with the stop at the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 同年8月8日假突破确立做空，约可空在6380点附近，停损设在前高6481点，风险约1.6%，达跌幅满足附近5681点附近，获利约11%。

rules.rule: After breaking out of the consolidation neckline, the neckline resistance becomes support; as long as support holds, look for 涨幅满足.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面4月3日突破整理区颈线后颈线压力变支撑，支撑不破看涨幅满足。

rules.rule: 涨幅满足 is computed once price climbs past the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 盘涨越过前高6797点后，便可计算涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Exit a long on a break of the rising trend line.
rules.quote_zh: 2006年1月18日跌破上升趋势线卖出，约可卖在6550点附近，获利约14%。

rules.rule: If the reversal at 涨幅满足 is a fast V-reversal and you could not exit in time, use the three-day low as reference: when the three-day low breaks (together with the up-trend line), exit. A direct V-reversal after a rally is rare on the TAIEX.
rules.quote_zh: 这次达涨幅满足的反转相当快速，是属于V型反转，若出脱不及可以三日低点为参考，当三日低点跌破时，也同时跌破上升趋势线，涨高后直接V型反转在台股指数属于较为少见的现象。

rules.rule: A false breakout: the broken neckline should be support for bulls; breaking that support means weakening.
rules.quote_zh: 同时在型态上也属假突破确立的卖出信号（颈线突破压力变支撑，多头看支撑，跌破支撑便属转弱）

rules.rule: Short when price breaks the up-trend line and the low of the volume breakout red candle; stop at the high of the line-breaking black candle.
rules.quote_zh: 2006年5月11日跌破上升趋势线，也跌破5月4日带量突破整理区的红K低点7278点，空单进场约可空在7270点，停损设5月11日破线黑K高点7361点风险约1.5%，达跌幅满足附近，空单获利了结约13%。

rules.rule: Breaking the rebound low is an add-on point for shorts, with the same stop on standing back above the line; take profit at 跌幅满足.
rules.quote_zh: 6月5日跌破反弹低点6791点时，也是空单加码点，同样站回线上停损，达跌幅满足附近，空单获利了结。

rules.rule: On the weekly chart, multiple successive 涨幅满足 targets can be computed from the same major low (5618) using each subsequent high and pullback low.
rules.quote_zh: 图示为5618低点计算三个波段高点的涨幅满足。

rules.rule: A weekly neckline breakout after a ~3-month base: neckline turns support; if it holds, look for the 涨幅满足 above the prior high.
rules.quote_zh: 同年9月下旬突破整理区上缘颈线，完成约三个月的底部，颈线6730点附近压力变支撑，支撑不破，看一路盘涨过前高后的涨幅满足附近。

rules.rule: A daily 破底翻 may show on the weekly chart only as a lower shadow; a weekly breakout over the prior high then allows computing 涨幅满足.
rules.quote_zh: 整理期间的日线3月初破底，3月中旬出现破底翻买进信号（周线为下影线），图示周线4月7日当周突破颈线，越过7999点前高，便可计算涨幅满足

rules.rule: Reaching the big-swing 涨幅满足 followed by a volume spike reversal begins a large top range and a long bear.
rules.quote_zh: 台股盘涨至同年7月下旬，达大波段涨幅满足附近（最高9807点）便爆量反转，随后大区间震荡作头进入长空型态。

rules.rule: A complex head-and-shoulders top with a double head is measured like an M top: distance from the line joining the head highs to the neckline equals the distance below the neckline break.
rules.quote_zh: 双头高点连接与颈线的直线距离=跌破颈线位置后的同等距离。

rules.rule: While neckline resistance is not reclaimed, keep looking for 跌幅满足.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面颈线压力未站回前看跌幅满足。

rules.rule: When the computed 跌幅满足 offers limited profit, the trade can be skipped.
rules.quote_zh: 这次计算跌幅满足获利幅度有限，可以不作操作。

rules.rule: A short aiming for a second-wave decline must stop out once a 破底翻 is confirmed; the weekly lower shadow that did not break the line is an important judgement tool.
rules.quote_zh: 若做空以相对规模来看，欲看第二波跌幅满足者，在破底翻确立后，须做停损动作，前一篇“2006-2007台股周线”为下影线未破线，也是重要的判断工具。

rules.rule: A near-record volume spike at the big-swing target followed by a false breakout is a very clear long-term sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 7月26日出现爆出几乎与历史大量相同的历史次天量，重点这是爆量假突破的结构，极为明显的长线卖出信号。

rules.rule: After a false breakout, a deep drop, a rebound, and a break of the prior low, compute 跌幅满足.
rules.quote_zh: 假突破跌深反弹后再破前低，便能计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Baruch: cut losses quickly and cleanly; don't expect never to be wrong.
rules.quote_zh: 要学会迅速而利落地砍断亏损。不要期待自己永远不犯错，而是在错误发生时，尽快砍掉亏损。

rules.rule: Kostolany: the key is judging which phase the market is in.
rules.quote_zh: 关键在于判断市场处于哪个阶段。

rules.rule: O'Neil: novices hold on while losses are small and let them grow out of emotion and wishful thinking.
rules.quote_zh: 大多数菜鸟散户在亏损还算少的时候死抱不放。他们原本可以在受伤不重的情况下退出，却受制于情绪和人性，一厢情愿地一再延误，造成亏损越来越大，终致损失惨重。

rules.rule: Kostolany: investing is an art; history and philosophy are more useful than statistics and mathematics.
rules.quote_zh: 股票投资是一门艺术，历史和哲学在投资决策时显然比统计学和数学更有用。

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 + 突破颈线 → 涨幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: high 7476 in early May 2006, volume drop 5/10 and up-trend-line break next day; V-reversal
reached ~6268 on 2006-06-09 then base; short profit ~13%

worked_examples.pattern: multi-wave 涨幅满足 from one low
worked_examples.outcome: 8090 target ~reached (7999, Jan 2007); 9687 target reached (9807, late Jul 2007) then volume reversal
target reached in ~4 trading days, then V-reversal back above neckline = 破底翻 buy; small profit, trade optional

worked_examples.pattern: 爆量假突破 → 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: low 7987 on 2007-08-17 (overshoot ~152), then sharp rebound within 1 day

quantifiable: 涨幅满足 (long): after close > prior_high, target = pullback_low + (prior_high − base_low); 跌幅满足 (short): after close < rebound_low, target = rebound_high − (top − first_low) (pp. 142, 143, 145, 147, 148, 151).
Multi-wave targets from one base low on weekly bars: for each new swing high H_i and subsequent pullback low L_i, target_i = L_i + (H_i − base_low) (pp. 147-148).
M-top / complex H&S target = neckline_at_break − (mean(head1, head2) − neckline) (pp. 149-150).
Exit long on close below the lowest low of the last 3 bars combined with up-trend-line break (V-reversal rule, p144).
False-breakout short trigger: after reaching near 涨幅满足, close below the up-trend line AND below the low of the most recent volume breakout candle; stop = high of the breaking candle (p146).
Skip trade if distance to target is small (e.g. ~4.4% profit vs 1.2% risk was deemed optional, p150).
Volume spike filter: volume at a new high ≈ historical max volume → long-term sell signal if followed by a close back below the breakout (p151).
Index stop risk in examples is 1.2%-2.2%; reward 4.4%-25%.
ambiguities: p146: entry 7270, stop 7361 is ~1.25% risk, but the book says ~1.5%.
p148 trade 1: buy 6870, profit ~13% — the exit level is not stated (the red target 8090 would be ~18%, the actual high 7999 ~16%).

p149: midpoint of the two head highs 7999.42 and 7990.55 is ~7995, book says ~7996; the break point ~7730 is a sloped-neckline value, while the height uses 7599 — how to read the neckline at the break point is not specified.
p147 chart dates (9/23, 4/7) are weekly bars; 2006-09-23 is a Saturday, so the 'date' is a week label, not a trading day.
Targets are often missed or overshot by 50-150 points (7523 vs 7476; 8090 vs 7999; 5681 vs 5618; 8139 vs 7987); the book treats all as 'near 满足' without a formal tolerance.
'三日低点' (three-day low) on p144 is not defined precisely (lowest low of the last three bars vs low three days ago).
p142 refers to '破底的颈线' — the neckline of the earlier broken bottom — whose level is on the preceding page (u14b), not in this unit.
